source: GDD gdd/lanebound-champions-v4.0-notion.md (Lanebound v4.0, L7 kit); look from champions/portraits/painted/brannoch/brannoch-1024.png (CD-7)
note: Blue faces right and red faces left. Blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Team tint only on the mantle clasp. Moss is a brighter leaf green (CD-7 portrait); lichen orange and slab buff stay off objective gold #F2C14E. Every hit is the hammer or the slab: smears, hit-stop, sparks at contact, cracks from the slab edge.

idle.note: slow breath; hammer on the back shoulder, slab in front

attack.note: hammer bash (melee 1.5): overhead swing, head lands on frame 3

cast.note: generic cast: hammer up, slab braced

bedrock.note: Passive Bedrock (below 50% HP, +20 PRes/MRes): stone grain creeps up the body on 0-3; frames 4-5 loop while it lasts

quarry.note: Q Quarry Throw: hammer knocks a block off the slab (1), grab (2), heave (3), release on 4 (0.30 s cast), line 6.5 x 0.6, slow 35% 1.5 s

shoulder.note: W Cairn Shoulder: 0.20 s crouch behind the slab (1-2), real charge up to 3.5 tiles (3-5), slab contact on 6, hit-stop 6-8, knockup 0.6 s

stonefast.note: R Stonefast: slab hauled overhead (1-2), driven down (3), slab edge hits the ground on 4 (0.40 s cast), hit-stop 4-6; cracks from the slab edge to r 2.6; petrify 1.6 s; Brannoch -25% damage 3 s (stone grain)

death.note: slab drops, kneel, fall; last frame holds

slow.note: Q: 35% slow 1.5 s, shared drag + slow plate

knockup.note: W: knockup 0.6 s, lift + stun plate

petrify.note: R: petrify 1.6 s (a stun): body turns granite from the feet up, NEW petrify plate; cracks off at the end
